title: Pottery Sale and Raku Party
commitment: Variable; can stay for whole process or drop off
summary: Public raku firing and paint-and-fire event on August 16, 2026. Choose from pre-made pieces like tiles, ring dishes, and candle holders to paint; watch them fired in under an hour.
how_to_join: Attend on August 16, 2026; no registration mentioned
source_quote: Pottery Sale and Raku Party, Sunday August 16, 2026
evidence_sentence: The event description states pieces will be painted and fired with raku, removed from the kiln while red hot and placed in sawdust for reduction.
evidence_quote: paint and fire Raku bits and baubles
pay_text: $10-$15 per piece to paint and fire
